# Read credentials from environment variables
user = os.getenv("ORACLE_USER", "system")
password = os.getenv("ORACLE_PASSWORD")
host = os.getenv("ORACLE_HOST", "localhost")
service = os.getenv("ORACLE_SERVICE", "ORCL")

# Build configuration object
config = OracleConnectorConfig(

    password=password,
    host=host,

# Execute query

```python
import os
from hamana.connector.db.oracle import OracleConnector, OracleConnectorConfig

# Read credentials from environment variables
user = os.getenv("ORACLE_USER", "system")
password = os.getenv("ORACLE_PASSWORD")
host = os.getenv("ORACLE_HOST", "localhost")
service = os.getenv("ORACLE_SERVICE", "ORCL")

# Build configuration object
config = OracleConnectorConfig(
    user=user,
    password=password,
    host=host,
    service=service
)

# Construct connector from configuration
connector = OracleConnector(config)

# Execute query
result = connector.execute("SELECT sysdate FROM dual")

# Print results
print(result.result)
```
